correctness.rationale: The unit-roof suspension gives a stationary edge process and Haar-uniform phase; vertex mass is zero and Kirchhoff balance characterizes marginals. All nonnegative circulations decompose into internal SCC cycles. The all-backward-trajectory quantifier forces any strongly backward invariant Borel set containing one state of an SCC to contain every internal edge state of it. Upstream closure of a minimal positive SCC separates mixtures. Incidence rank proves dimensions. Entropy chain rule makes the stationary Markov lift maximal, and a Perron relative-entropy identity proves the sharp endpoint; connectedness gives the entire interval. The details, quantifiers and boundary cases are proved in RESULT.md. The finite checker supports but does not replace the infinite all-graph proof.

value.rationale: The natural finite switching-flow family admits an exact, computable characterization of which stationary state marginals satisfy an all-continuation ergodic condition. It also determines the dimension of every such convex ergodic face and every achievable sharp lift-entropy level, demonstrating arbitrarily high-dimensional families of nonextreme yet coarse-ergodic measures. This structural compatibility of ergodicity and nonextremality is significant precisely because choosing an individual Markov transition law would give a different invariant notion.
